What we do

24×7 automated replies, lead capture and support.

  • Conversations designed around your top questions: prices, timings, locations, eligibility, bookings.
  • Lead capture that asks the right questions and qualifies before handing over.
  • Bookings and callbacks scheduled inside the chat.
  • Clear hand-off to a human whenever the customer asks or the bot is unsure.
  • Conversation records and lead lists in your dashboard or CRM.

Questions

Will customers know it's a bot?

Yes. The bot introduces itself and offers a person at any point.
